info.title: Stride
info.description: A private, local-first running log with native Garmin ingest. Your data stays on your machine; sharing is Garmin's business, not ours.

post.description:
Connect with a Garmin Connect Personal API Key.

This is the recommended path: no developer registration, no consumer
secret, and it covers activities *and* wellness (sleep, HRV, body
battery, resting heart rate).

post.description:
Import one or more ``.FIT`` files. No Garmin credentials required.

The files may come from any watch — a Strava export, a COROS or Wahoo
download, a Garmin Connect export. What the file says about itself is
what it is read as.

A run that is already in the history is not added twice: the run that
was synced from Garmin and the file that was exported from the watch are
the same run, and the store must hold it once.

post.description:
Load a chosen span of history from Garmin.

The Activity API serves the account's whole history, so "everything" is a
real option; the per-activity FIT download is what makes it slow, so this
runs in the background and reports progress.

get.description:
The plans Stride can offer, each judged by its own ruler.

``inferred`` is the baseline: the athlete's own usual week, derived
from their history, and never reported as missed. ``garmin`` is the
prescription: the scheduled workouts they wrote down.

get.description:
Compare two or more runs on the same parameters.

Every run is resampled onto a shared distance axis, so the heart-rate,
cadence, pace and elevation curves can be read against one another even
when the runs are different lengths.

HistoryBody.title: HistoryBody
HistoryBody.description:
How much history to load.

``activities`` is a number of months, or ``None`` for everything the
Garmin account holds. ``health_days`` is how far back to pull sleep,
resting heart rate, stress and body battery — Garmin keeps roughly a year
of those, and its stats range endpoints refuse a window longer than about
four weeks, so the pull is chunked.
